digest.component_or_area: LLM gate step-failure recording and reporting
propositions: The survived-LLM-step-failure tally sink was only active in review-plan and needs to be extended to review-code and verify-completion gates
The step-failure recording site is already universal through PydanticAIRunner.run but scope activation is missing for review-code (gate_dispatch.py:480) and verify-completion (gate_dispatch.py:696)
review-code and verify-completion verdicts must expose the tally as coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, mirroring the plan-review verdict structure
The completion verdict is signed and must remain byte-identical on clean runs, so the coverage object must be created only when the tally contains failures
Both code_review_verdict.schema.json and completion_verdict.schema.json must declare the coverage.llm_step_failures block with required fields [total, by_step]
